references.text: God responds to the people's complaint and the spies' negative report by declaring that those who lacked faith will not see the promised land.
Moses reminds how the spies discouraged the people from entering the land and caused them to lose heart.
Moses recounts the people's fear after the spies' report, in which they said the people were greater and taller than themselves.
Moses rebukes the people for their lack of faith despite the Lord having promised to fight for them.
Caleb reminds that he followed the Lord wholeheartedly, unlike the other spies who made the people lose heart.
The book of Hebrews points out that the Israelites could not enter the land because of unbelief, as represented by the spies' negative report.
